name: Arrow, Electroshock
description: An electroshock arrow is a specialized arrow for use with bow weapons. When you hit a creature with this arrow, the creature must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 1d3 ion damage and becomes stunned until the start of its next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and isn’t stunned. Once the arrow hits a target, it no longer gives a bonus.
